foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat statutory total fee of $185.00 for the application for a certificate of authority.
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an annual renewal with the Secretary of State by December 31 of each calendar year (no fee) and maintain a registered office and agent for service of process in Minnesota.

evidence.quote: Before transacting business in this state, a foreign limited liability company shall obtain a certificate of authority to transact business in this state by filing an application with the secretary of state together with a total fee of $185.
(5) the name and street address of the company's initial registered office and agent for service of process in this state.

(b) Each calendar year beginning in the calendar year following the calendar year in which a limited liability company and foreign limited liability company files articles of organization, a limited liability company and foreign limited liability company must file with the secretary of state by December 31 of each calendar year a renewal containing the items required by section 5.34 . Notwithstanding section 322C.0205, subdivision 1 , no fee is required to file an annual renewal.

notes: The statute sets the $185.00 'total fee' for the foreign LLC application for a certificate of authority and names the annual renewal obligation; no fee is required for the annual renewal. The record cites the Revisor of Statutes' official pages because sos.state.mn.us is behind a Radware captcha on the collecting route.
